Primary_bulk_risk_concordant_state.Name: Cycling-G2M
Primary_bulk_risk_concordant_state.Rationale: Strongest cross-patient convergence of Hub18, high-risk direct biological programs and inverse metabolic programs across HCC08, HCC09 and HCC10.

Secondary_bulk_risk_concordant_state.Name: Hypoxia-TGFb-Inflammatory
Secondary_bulk_risk_concordant_state.Rationale: Positive cross-patient convergence with strong hypoxia, TGFb, EMT/ECM and inflammatory biology, but less robust than MS3.

Supportive_bulk_risk_concordant_state.Name: Stress-Inflammatory-Progenitor
Supportive_bulk_risk_concordant_state.Rationale: Positive but weaker two-patient convergence with progenitor and inflammatory features.

Primary_bulk_risk_opposing_state.Name: Hepatic-Differentiated
Primary_bulk_risk_opposing_state.Rationale: Strong and consistent negative convergence with marked hepatic differentiation and opposing metabolic biology across HCC09 and HCC10.

Interpretation: The results support a cross-cohort biological axis linking bulk poor-prognosis biology with a proliferative malignant state and the opposing direction with a differentiated hepatic/metabolic malignant state. These labels represent biological concordance rather than direct clinical-risk assignment to individual scRNA patients.
Next_step: Step25 will test the robustness and portability of the MS3 risk-concordant state and the MS3-versus-MS6 axis across patients before mechanistic downstream analyses.
